visual_species: Male red fancy Poecilia reticulata visual study

references.license: CC BY-SA 3.0; reference only, no image pixels redistributed
references.observed: Actual red fancy male with slender body, silver head/abdomen, conspicuous iris, large rounded red fan tail, red soft dorsal, tiny clear paired fins and a narrow modified anal fin.

limitations: Original red fancy male Poecilia reticulata visual study based on the inspected Przemyslaw Malkowski photo. Ornamental strains vary; the modified anal fin is simplified, fine dentition is omitted and swimming is artist-tuned.
